As with all renovations in a circa 1962 house, there are unforeseen circumstances and imperfections that need to be corrected with additional materials and workmanship.  Our job was no different,  but Stephen didn't 'nickel & dime' us with change orders and took care of these things while honoring his original quote and emphasizing all along the way that our satisfaction with the finished product was the most important goal. The attached pictures don't do the in person view of this job justice.  It all came out absolutely beautiful and my wife and I are extremely pleased with the results. Complete new kitchen, floor, smooth ceiling,  electric, lighting fixtures, appliances,  counters, backsplash and custom shelves and island on wheels !!
